remarks: First time on the market in decades. Same family owned for 40 + years. This lovely and well maintained two family home offers two spacious units with large rooms, off street parking, two garage spaces, separate utilities, gas boilers and water heaters, vinyl siding and maintenance free front porch. Great location for commuters and beachgoers. Close to everything Stamford has to offer. Perfect for landlords or owner occupied users. Walk to beach, parks, gyms and stores. unit 1: (1st FL) H/W floors throughout, Eat in Kitchen with large pantry, One Bedroom, one Bath, One Living Room and one den that can be used as an extra bedroom Unit 2: (2nd & 3rd FL) Eat in Kitchen, One Living Room, 3 Bedrooms,2 full baths, a Den that can be used as 4th Bedroom and an extra space/office on the 3rd FL between those bedrooms. One full bath on each FL. Nice Doors, some with Glass panels, Archways Lots of Closets in both units and laundry in the basement. A really Nice Place !
